format: JSONL authoritative; one final row per action_event_id

excluded_fields: age/profile fields not consumed by move selection
retained_potentially_identifying_fields: mathematical dialogue needed by the selector
privacy.student_identifier: deterministic dataset-scoped SHA-256 pseudonym; raw id omitted

semantics.collector_execution: copy-only; no model or evaluator execution
semantics.delta_mastery: confidence-weighted BKT posterior belief update after resolved evidence; not a reward or causal effect
semantics.formal_assessment: stored separately and never joined to the last Tutor action
